description: This source file contains unit tests that ensure the codebase does not use legacy non-throwing FileHandle read APIs. It scans through Swift source files in the project to detect usage patterns like 'readDataToEndOfFile(' and '.availableData'. The file defines a test structure with methods for locating Swift files, stripping comments and strings from source code, and executing the test to verify the absence of legacy APIs.
